independence_declaration.statement: I (domain-reviewer, session ec854747) authored no implementation, register entry or decision in the DG1 scope. I formed this verdict from the frozen candidate, my own runtime checks on a disposable clone and my own screenshots, before reading any other round-1 review record. I read none of them.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate: HEAD vs freeze commit (only excluded metadata after it), recompute the candidate ID, full clone, DG0 historical validation
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git diff --stat 85e5bbd..HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG0 --historical
checks_run.expected: Candidate ID sha256:7fcc4943…9367; post-freeze diff limited to excluded metadata; not shallow; DG0 PASS
checks_run.actual: HEAD 863505e only adds assignments/, candidates/ manifest and stages.json (all excluded per D-005); candidate_id sha256:7fcc4943694dc9d7d207b18b53c42eab1efa131da46b898f733ae20298b39367 (371 files); shallow=false; 'PASS gate DG0 (historical)'

checks_run.procedure: Read erd.md and data-dictionary.md against §16 M0316–M0329 and the playbook: 12 entity groups and 81 entities; canonical decision, dependency and benefit records; P1 tables and constraints; charter 14 fields (B0035); 5 forums (M0191–M0195); 10 TOM dimensions; 25-question health check; benefit_allocation with no double counting; finance_validation FIN-only
checks_run.command: cat docs/architecture/erd.md docs/architecture/data-dictionary.md; sed -n 155,200p docs/source/playbook.md; awk '/§16\] 16 /,/§17\] 17 /' docs/source/master-prompt.anchored.md
checks_run.expected: Every §16 entity is mapped to a table and stage; typed relational core; jsonb only for validated extensible fields; canonical shared records reserved coherently
checks_run.actual: All 81 entities mapped, P1 tables marked. One decision model (T04/T11/T16/gate/funding), one dependency (T08+RAID), one benefit register plus allocation (≤100%, no double counting), FinanceValidation FIN-only, KPIActual separates observation period, business date and event timestamp. Charter = 14 source fields (matches B0035). Five forums, 10 TOM dimensions and a 25-question health check match the sources. Typed tables; jsonb only for audit changes, outbox payload (zod-validated) and custom_field_values against form_schema_version.

checks_run.procedure: Apply migrations 0001–0006 to a fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16 cluster and compare the public tables with the ERD P1 table list; check that there are no float or money columns and that org defaults are Asia/Riyadh/SAR/ar
checks_run.environment: disposable clone of 85e5bbd in $TMPDIR, PostgreSQL 16.13 (initdb in $TMPDIR), API AUTH_MODE=dev, SYNTHETIC dev seed
checks_run.expected: 6 migrations apply; 17 public tables equal the ERD P1 list; 0 real/double/money columns; defaults Asia/Riyadh|SAR|ar
checks_run.actual: applied 6 migration(s); tables app_user, audit_event, business_unit, delegation, idempotency_record, oidc_login_state, organization, outbox_event, permission, processed_message, role, role_permission, schema_migration, scoped_assignment, session, transformation, user_identity (all ERD P1 tables = t); float/money columns = 0; 'Asia/Riyadh|SAR|ar'

checks_run.procedure: Verify that technical admins are never business or Finance approvers: the seeded role/permission matrix through the API, the DB trigger on a direct owner insert, and the self-grant block for ADM_ACCESS
checks_run.command: scenario.sh steps 13–14; scenario2.sh step 12 (psql as owner: insert ADM_TECH + finance.validate)
checks_run.expected: ADM_* hold no gate.decide/finance.validate; trigger raises; self-grant 422; only FIN holds finance.validate; SP/BO hold gate.decide
checks_run.actual: Roles API: ADM_TECH/ADM_ACCESS/ADM_METHOD have only configure/read permissions and no transformation.read; FIN alone has finance.validate; SP and BO have gate.decide. Trigger: 'technical administrator role ADM_TECH cannot hold approval permission finance.validate (separation of duties)'. Admin self-grant SP -> 422 access.self_grant. Admin GET of a transformation -> 404, list -> empty. ADR-0006: an approver right comes only through a separate audited business-role grant, which is consistent with M0188 'not automatically'.

checks_run.procedure: Create transformations via the API: End-to-End with no tz/currency (expect Asia/Riyadh/SAR, phase diagnose, draft); Modular with entryPhase=design, a standalone TOM and USD/Europe/London; Modular without entryPhase (expect rejection); attempt a currentPhase change
checks_run.expected: Defaults applied; modes and standalone deliverables match B0008/B0009/M0095; phase only changes through gates; draft is not submitted or approved
checks_run.actual: E2E -> status draft, currentPhase diagnose, Asia/Riyadh, SAR. Modular TOM -> currentPhase design, USD, Europe/London (configurable). Modular without entryPhase -> 400 validation.required /entryPhase. PATCH currentPhase -> 400 unknown_field. The UI says 'created as a draft. It is not submitted or approved.'

checks_run.procedure: Operating logic: delivery, adoption, validated value and closure are separate; closure needs value realization (B0014, M0092, REQ-S03-003 'TL after G6'). Exercise status transitions as TO through the API and UI.
checks_run.command: scenario2.sh steps 3–6, 8; domrev-shots.mjs (edit form options, detail page)
checks_run.environment: disposable stack as above; Chromium 1194 headless (/opt/pw-browsers)
checks_run.expected: P1 offers no transformation closure (no G6, no benefit register yet), or blocks it
checks_run.actual: draft->closed 422, but active->closed 200 (status closed, currentPhase diagnose, audit reason null); closed->active 422 (terminal). The UI edit form offers Active/On hold/Closed (EN) and نشطة/معلّقة/مغلقة (AR). See F-DG1-001.

checks_run.procedure: Check that missing data shows as Unknown, never zero or green, on the transformation workspace header and in the token semantics
checks_run.expected: Gate readiness, North Star, outcome health, benefits, decisions and next action shown as Unknown with a label and an icon; distinct Unknown/Stale tokens; blue never means favourable
checks_run.actual: All six fields show 'غير معروف ?' / 'Unknown ?' with the note 'Unknown means the data does not exist yet. It is never shown as zero or as on track.' status.unknown and status.stale are separate non-green tokens; on-track is green, not blue.

checks_run.procedure: GET /api/v1/branding/tokens unauthenticated and as a signed-in user; compare the seven values with M0293–M0299; check provenance; read tokens.json
checks_run.expected: 401 unauthenticated; provenance=provisional; brand.primary #0078FF, brand.deep #003B73, surface.page #F5F8FC, surface.card #FFFFFF, text.primary #142438, text.secondary #526174, border.default #DCE5EF, each provisional
checks_run.actual: 401; {"provenance":"provisional","tokens":[…seven tokens with exactly these values and purposes, provisional:true…]}

checks_run.procedure: Search product code, docs and the OpenAPI for claims of official Mobily branding, official PMI status or certification; inspect the About screen in EN and AR; inspect the wordmark
checks_run.command: git grep -n -i -E 'pmi|certif|official|complian' HEAD -- apps packages docs/architecture docs/api (negations filtered); domrev-shots.mjs /about
checks_run.environment: candidate tree; disposable stack with Chromium headless
checks_run.expected: No claim of official brand or PMI status; methodology described as a synthesis inspired by PMI/Brightline/BRM; provisional wordmark badge
checks_run.actual: The only remaining hits are explicit negations (About text EN/AR: 'not an official PMI standard … not certified by PMI or any other body'; architecture README). The header shows the text wordmark with a 'Provisional'/'مؤقت' badge, and the About page explains that #0078FF is provisional. No logo image.

checks_run.procedure: Run the no-CDN scanner and the contrast check on the candidate build; read the About font statement
checks_run.environment: disposable clone of 85e5bbd, Node v22.22.2, pnpm 10.33.0 (offline)
checks_run.actual: PASS no-cdn: scanned apps, packages. PASS contrast: 50 pairs meet WCAG AA; 3 prohibited pairs fail as documented (#0078FF is not used for body text). About: IBM Plex Sans Arabic/IBM Plex Sans, OFL 1.1, bundled.

checks_run.procedure: Render My Work, About, transformation edit/detail/create and the TL post-create page in EN and AR; check html lang/dir; check i18n key parity; compare Arabic domain terms with docs/analysis/glossary.md
checks_run.command: SHOTS=$TMPDIR/shots qa-stack.sh node domrev-shots.mjs; node key-parity script over apps/web/src/i18n/{en,ar}
checks_run.expected: EN lang=en dir=ltr, AR lang=ar dir=rtl; full key parity; Arabic domain terms match the approved glossary
checks_run.actual: EN ltr and AR rtl confirmed; key parity 0 differences across 6 catalogues (412 keys). Terminology deviates: Transformation = 'مبادرة التحول' (collides with Initiative), Modular = 'معياري', Phase 5 = 'التحول' (F-DG1-003). Audit 'Changes' shows raw codes (F-DG1-005).

checks_run.procedure: REQ-S16-001 acceptance: start the separate worker process against the running API's database, then SIGTERM it and probe the API
checks_run.expected: Worker runs as its own process and relays the outbox; after it stops, the API still serves
checks_run.actual: Worker alive, relayed 1 outbox event and handled transformation.created; exit 0 on SIGTERM; /readyz afterwards 200 {status:ready}; the API still answered requests. The register note says no automated test covers this (F-DG1-006).

checks_run.procedure: Build every workspace package of the candidate (TypeScript strict, React 19 + Vite) and lint the OpenAPI contract
checks_run.environment: disposable clone of 85e5bbd, Node v22.22.2, pnpm 10.33.0 (offline, copied node_modules)
checks_run.actual: build_exit=0 (web built by Vite, api/worker/db by tsc); 'PASS docs/api/openapi.yaml: OpenAPI 3.1.1, 33 operations' (the register note says 32, F-DG1-006)

checks_run.procedure: Judge D-047: compare apps/api/src/modules.ts, architecture.test.ts and the module directories with M0308 and the REQ-S16-003 register acceptance
checks_run.command: cat apps/api/src/modules.ts; grep it( apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts; ls apps/api/src/modules
checks_run.expected: Boundaries reflect the domain areas; a correct P1 increment; register classification honest
checks_run.actual: Domain decomposition is faithful: identity, access, organization, transformations, methodology, workflows (gates/approvals/decisions/SoD), kpi (calc), reporting, evidence, jobs and admin, with an acyclic dependsOn graph and a dependency-lint. Deferral to P2/P4/P5 is correct. But workflows/kpi/reporting do not exist as code or suites, while REQ-S16-003 (and, by the same pattern, REQ-S16-004's A19 restore) is marked IMPLEMENTED at its DG1 final gate (F-DG1-002).

checks_run.procedure: Real user outcome for a TL with a business-unit grant: create, then open the created transformation
checks_run.expected: Scope rules hold (no implicit grant), and the user is not left at a dead end
checks_run.actual: Create 201, then GET/PATCH 404 and the UI shows 'Not found' for the user's own new record (F-DG1-004, Low). The scope rule itself matches ADR-0006 and the permissions matrix.

checks_run.procedure: Check that nothing in P1 lets an engineering or automation path grant a G1–G6, Finance or IT approval: permissions catalogue, routes using gate.decide/finance.validate, and service principals
checks_run.command: grep -rn 'gate.decide\|finance.validate' apps packages (non-test); read ADR-0006 SoD hooks and rules.ts sod.service_cannot_approve
checks_run.expected: No P1 route uses approval permissions; service principals cannot approve; DG gates are not referenced as product approvals
checks_run.actual: gate.decide and finance.validate exist only in the catalogue, the seed and the SoD trigger; no P1 route declares them. rules.ts denies service principals approval ('sod.service_cannot_approve'). The UI draft text states that nothing is submitted or approved.

summary: FAIL. The architecture, data model, scoped RBAC/SoD, provisional branding, fonts, Unknown-not-zero semantics and provenance honesty are faithful to the playbook and master prompt. Three Medium findings block. F-DG1-001 (mandatory): P1 allows terminal transformation closure with no G6 and no validated value. F-DG1-002: REQ-S16-003/004 are marked IMPLEMENTED although their acceptance is unmet; the D-047 architecture itself is a faithful P1 increment. F-DG1-003: Arabic domain terms deviate from the approved glossary and label a Transformation as an Initiative. Three Low observations: F-DG1-004, F-DG1-005, F-DG1-006.
